note: outside the 12 cells: イオン気仙沼 (OSM supermarket 'イオン', lot 16/58540/25072/110, 72 x 149 m, 10 407 m2). The derived 2 storeys / 6.1 m / mono-pitch roof drew a 46 m wedge (town/kit/house.js had no cap on the pitch). Commons 'AEON Kesennuma 202509a.jpg' (2025-09-19) shows a flat-roofed 2-storey mall: pale pink-beige horizontally banded walls, a roof deck with green railings, the main body about 11-12 m. The height, storeys and roof shape are also in world/lotfix.js (LOT_FIX); the sign tower is town/signtower.js (LOT_TOWER). LOT_FIX cannot set colours, so the wall and roof colours are here.
